title: Buffalo Chicken Wraps
steps:
Slice chicken thin,
salt and pepper,
cook in butter 6-7 min

Save a few plain strips,
toss the rest
in buffalo sauce

Lettuce, chicken, cheese,
celery, carrots, ranch.
Roll it up tight
vo: Wrap night, on the table in about twenty-five minutes.
You need chicken breast, buffalo sauce, ranch, big flour tortillas, lettuce, cheddar and carrots.
Slice the chicken thin, season it, and cook it in a little butter for six or seven minutes.
Save a few plain strips for anyone who hates spice, and toss the rest in buffalo sauce.
Fill each tortilla with lettuce, chicken, cheese, celery and carrots, drizzle with ranch, and roll it up tight.
